chapter: Life on the road and in the Webb band's book
title: Cozy Cole, a learned drummer
summary: McRae calls Cozy a master who played with philharmonic orchestras.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Oh, Cozy could sit in anybody's band. Cozy was a master.
Remember, Cozy was a learned drummer. Cozy played with the Philharmonics. Cozy can play with the Boston Pop -- anything.
Cozy knows all the drums. He's just not a drummer, he can play triangles, cymbals, tympanis. He played the Philharmonics.
In fact, he studied with one of the drummers in the Philharmonics.
